messages:
joel_sales: quick ping — HelixFrame asked to POC helixframe-chronos-29b:q9. asks: catalog presence, variant compatibility for Dedicated + Private, BYOW (they may supply weights), KMS/EKM with Entrust HSM, KV-cache memory impact, and a POC price ballpark. can someone triage?

mara_s: contact info? workload shape?

joel_sales: contact is rachel@helixframe.com. workload = high-concurrency RAG + nightly bulk embeddings; contexts often 8k-12k, heavy KV reuse. They want EU residency and Entrust HSM for keys.

dennis_ops: q9 is an experimental 9-bit layout for better compute; need to run compatibility scan on a100-80 and an onprem VM for Private/BYOW. kicking off now.

presales-bot: scan started: job=helix_q9_scan_12. checks: kv-cache, kernel-compat, tokenization, byow-path. ETA ~6m.

dennis_ops: quick note: KV cache retained in fp16 increases memory; estimate +12%. q9 runtime could reduce compute ~-18% but packing requires runtime v2.10+ for a100 kernel path.

presales-bot: scan complete. job=helix_q9_scan_12. summary: kernel patch required on older nodes (shim available), KV-cache overhead +11.8%, tokenization parity OK except rare edge-case (~0.14%), BYOW allowed on Private with checksum + attestation. report: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/helix_q9_scan_12/report.html

anya_sec: security draft: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS. External HSM/EKM (Entrust) supported with ops integration and acceptance tests; FIPS/HSM attestation handled under enterprise onboarding. BYOW allowed on Private under BYOW addendum (integrity checks + liability attestation)."

joel_sales: timeline for quote and ops validation if they request Entrust EKM?

dennis_ops: ops estimate: basic validation + smoke = 1-2 business days. Entrust EKM integration + rotation/attestation = 3-6 business days depending on vendor. BYOW verification = 2 business days for checksum & license attestation.

legal-bot: draft BYOW clause: "Customer-supplied weights accepted for Private deployments only; customer must attest license rights and checksum integrity. Redistribution prohibited. Redwood will perform verification and may refuse unsupported binaries."

joel_sales: price ask — rough POC delta q9 vs fp16 on Dedicated? include one-time EKM setup fee?

dennis_ops: rough: q9 runtime compute -18% vs fp16; infra memory +12% from KV retention; one-time EKM setup fee and validation charged as a separate line. I'll pass numbers to billing.

joel_sales: can we include a small repro snippet for the tokenization edge-case so HelixFrame can validate locally?

dennis_ops: dropping repro:
```
# repro (rare token shift ~0.14%)
Prompt: "Summarize: \"Status: 'Deploy @ 09:00 (TZ=UTC+1)'\" with nested quotes and special chars \u23F0"
```

dennis_ops: reproduced locally; patch ready (branch: rt/helix/q9-token-fix) if they want exact parity pre-POC.

joel_sales: assigning follow-ups: dennis = ops validation + token-fix PR, anya = finalize security text for Entrust + FIPS note, legal-bot = BYOW addendum, billing will compose POC quote. I'll email Rachel with the scan link and tentative timelines.

presales-bot: suggested fallback policy: route to helixframe-lite-7b:fp16 as automatic fallback at p95 memory > threshold; start with 5% canary for 24h.

joel_sales: perfect. I'll send initial outreach now. Reopen if HelixFrame asks for deeper perf traces. :thumbsup:
